name: CTA — centered spotlight
description: Centered composition on a mesh gradient built from tint tokens: icon badge → large two-line heading → subtitle with a footnote → one configurable action. Soft entrance (fadeIn), optional full-height mode. Opens or closes a page.

contentSlots.title: large heading, 2 lines (text-balance)
contentSlots.subtitle: one sentence below the heading, optional
contentSlots.footnote: optional footnote link (marker + href), rendered as sup; pass null in code to suppress the showcase default
